environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on a standard EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, JDK 17, with the application running as the 'app' user. The filesystem contains /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, application secrets in /app/secrets/db_credentials.properties, and AWS instance metadata accessible. No filesystem isolation or containerization is applied. The service listens on port 8080 with an NLB forwarding TCP traffic directly.

config.filesystem: full host filesystem accessible to app user
